name: Mech Probe (research)
description: Research for Voymastina's Sinbreaker: logs how the game seats you in an exosuit, how its arms and its shield bash register, and tries three things on a key while you pilot (F9: a one-second physics charge forward, F10: a 3 m warp, F11: a shield-arm thrust). Methods from Apache - Rise Above (Riggs, after Khi), EXO Beacon Launcher (enochlophobianumerophobia, MIT) and HD2Runtime research. Also logs a lead for the movement input (keys held, camera, movement) for her dashes. Turn off when done.
